newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SILF Purchasing managers index up to 55.5 in Feb.
newsitem.headline: SILF Purchasing managers index up to 55.5 in Feb.

text.p: The SILF/Swedbank purchasing managers' index rose to 55.5 in February, from 53.3 in January, Swedbank said on Monday.
"The total index rose in February and clearly exceeded the level indicating growth in the industry," Swedbank said in a statement.
"The figure for the total index was the highest since the autumn of 1995. The upturn in the industrial economic cycle is still, however, relatively calm."

Order intake increased further in February, the bank said. The upturn largely stemmed from a continued strong order intake on the export market, but domestic order intake also increased, the bank said.
"It was also gratifying that the increased order intake resulted in growing order stocks," the bank said.
Production and planned production in the next six months also increased.
"Companies' expectations about production development has strengthened gradually in the latest months," Swedbank said.
